## About Us

Jaryan is a professional sewage and sanitation services company serving the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia, with a focus on Al-Ahsa, Dammam, Khobar, and Jubail. We provide 24/7 emergency services for all sewage-related issues.

## Services

### Core Services
- **Drain Cleaning (تسليك المجاري)**: Professional drain and sewer line cleaning using modern equipment
- **Septic Tank Pumping (شفط البيارات)**: Modern vacuum trucks for all tank sizes
- **Cleaning & Sanitization (تنظيف وتعقيم)**: Complete sanitization to eliminate odors and bacteria

### Service Areas
